title: fix(cli): os migrate stored-references reads a database the release has not booted yet (ADR-0150 D10)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBCwJb6YUE6XtB5P6jqgdPzy)_

Fixes #32095

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** `os migrate stored-references`（ADR-0150 D10 升级报告）在 18.4 首次启动之前、对 18.3.0 写下的库运行时，不再以 `INVALID_FILTER` 退出 1。缺 package 列的 D8 表按“尚无绑定”读取：每行都视为没有 package，照常问那一条解析规则，列出的正是首次启动的回填会留空、需要人工 bind 的那些行；另打一条提示，点名缺列的表。
- **为什么改:** 这个报告存在的意义就是升级时用，而运维最可能在升级后、首次启动前跑它；18.3.0 的 D8 表全部没有 package 列（只读启动不会加列），第一张表 `sys_user_permission_set` 就让整个报告失败，发布路径上的 p1。
- **风险与回滚:** 只动 cli 一个命令的读取路径；报告仍只读（不加列、不写行），`--json` 文档形状不变，退出码契约不变。只认启动时实测的缺列（暂缓的 schema sync 的 `add_columns`），其它读取失败照旧抛出、退出 1。回滚 = revert。
- **先看:** `packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts` 的 `collectStoredPackageReferences`（`packageColumnPresent` 一行）与 `refusedRowsOf`；`stored-references/index.ts` 的 `packageColumnReads`。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts -t "has not booted"`，预期 3 个用例通过。
- **需要你做的:** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

Card choice (the order asked me to pick one of the card's two options and say why): **the report reads a table that predates its package column as "nothing bound yet"**: every row names no package, so each is asked the one D3 rule and reported only when the rule refuses it. I did not pick "name the condition and stop", for three reasons:

1. **It is the state the report already reads.** A present package column that the backfill has not filled yet is null on every row, and the report already asks each such row the rule ("a resolved row is not a finding: the next boot's backfill binds a package holder"). A missing column holds exactly that, so the report answers both the same way. The findings are the rows the first boot's backfill will leave null. The THE PIN case below shows they are byte-equal to the findings on the same database once its columns exist.
2. **The `--json` reader keeps a complete `stored`.** With "name the condition", a script reading `stored` before the first boot would get `[]` and read "nothing to review" while ambiguous rows exist. With this reading `stored` is right in both states, and the document's shape does not change. That is why this PR is `Clause-②: no`.
3. **The next step it prints still works.** Measured: on the same unbooted database, `bind` boots as a write, so the ordinary additive sync adds the columns, and it writes the one row.

The change itself:

- `packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts`: `collectStoredPackageReferences` takes `packageColumnAbsent(table, column)`. For a D8 table whose package column the caller measured missing, `refusedRowsOf` reads every row with neither the package-column filter nor the package column in `fields`. The module doc gains "A database this release has not booted yet".
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-references/index.ts`: `packageColumnReads(stack.pendingSchemaWork)` answers that question from the read-only boot's held-back sync. `add_columns` is the driver's own diff of declared columns against the table's columns, a fact about the database. It is keyed by physical table, as `tableAbsent` is (`StorageNameMapping`). The command prints one notice naming each table and the column it lacks: stdout in the text face, stderr under `--json`, as `absentTableReads` does. No column is added: the report never calls `flushSchemaDdl`. Exit codes are unchanged (0 when the report ran).
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`: one sentence in the command's row.
- `.changeset/32095-stored-references-unbooted-database.md`: `@objectstack/cli` patch.

⛔ Never recognised as this state: a refused read. Only the measured package column is read this way. Any other missing column, and any other driver error, is still thrown, and the command still exits 1.

## Tests

Added in `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts` as a new top-level `describe`, "a database this release has not booted yet". The database is the suite's own template with every D8 package column dropped, plus each index naming one. That is the 18.3.0 shape: at the 18.3.0 release commit `83d7e4ae`, none of the D8 package columns is declared, and R3's caller column `package_id` already is.

- **THE PIN:** exit 0. The `stored` rows are `R3 environment-only` and `R5 ambiguous`, equal to the run on the same database with its columns (the one-holder control row is never listed). `tablesAbsent` is `[]`. One notice names `sys_user_permission_set (permission_set_package)`, `sys_audience_binding_suggestion (permission_set_package)` and `sys_sharing_rule (package_id)`. Afterwards no dropped column exists and no row moved.
- **Bind:** on the same unbooted database, `bind` of the R5 row is `bound`, written 1, and the row then carries B.
- **Never swallowed:** a fake engine refuses the read `INVALID_FILTER`/400 on a table whose package column was not measured missing (the measurement names another table). `collectStoredPackageReferences` rejects with that envelope, and the read it issued carried the `permission_set_package: null` filter and field.

Ablations. Each was committed first and run with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, through the new describe (`-t "has not booted yet"`, 3 cases). The test imports `src` by relative path, so no dist is involved. Every restore was verified: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

<details><summary>A1 (the fix): read the package column on every table again</summary>

`const packageColumnPresent = true /* ablated-1 */;` → THE PIN red, the other two green. This is the card's failure, reproduced:

```
× THE PIN: reads each table as nothing bound yet: exit 0, the rows the backfill will leave null, one notice, no column added
AssertionError: {"error":"A filter on object 'sys_user_permission_set' names a column the database could not resolve, so the predicate never ran. …","code":"INVALID_FILTER"}: expected 'A filter on object \'sys_user_permiss…' to be undefined
Tests  1 failed | 2 passed | 9 skipped (12)
```
</details>

<details><summary>A2 (nothing is written): add the columns during the report</summary>

`await stack.flushSchemaDdl();` before the `--json` document is emitted → THE PIN red, on the read-only assertion alone:

```
AssertionError: sys_user_permission_set.permission_set_package: expected [ 'id', 'created_at', …(13) ] to not include 'permission_set_package'
Tests  1 failed | 2 passed | 9 skipped (12)
```
(The first A2 attempt was refused by the tool and ran nothing: its replacement contained the anchor, so the anchor count stayed at 1. It was rerun with a respelled replacement.)
</details>

<details><summary>A3 (never swallowed): read a refused read as no rows</summary>

`engine.find(…).catch(() => [])` → the never-swallowed pin red:

```
× only a column the boot measured missing is read that way: a refused read is thrown, never read as nothing bound
AssertionError: promise resolved "{ stored: [], picklists: [], …(4) }" instead of rejecting
Tests  1 failed | 2 passed | 9 skipped (12)
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The `run` helper in that file now also returns the `console.error` text (`stderr`), so a case can read the `--json` notice. Existing cases ignore it.
- #31985's PR #32081 edits the same test file (the header and the `ai` fixture). This PR adds a header paragraph lower down, the helper field and a describe at the end. Expect a clean or trivial merge.

## Verification

All local readings are at head `55d4e10b`, on a branch whose merge base is current `origin/main` (`45f0f81f`, unmoved since the branch was cut).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts`: 1 file, **12/12 passed** (9 existing + 3 new). I ran this layer locally because the diff touches an integration file.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: **412/412 files, 5874/5874 tests**, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` + `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- `npx eslint --no-inline-config` on the three touched source files: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: **99 families derived, each run, each exit 0**, after a full `turbo run build` (120/120) so that no build-reading gate answered exit 3. `--ran`: 99 derived, 99 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The record is `gates-ran.list` in the card's project folder.
- Full dogfood: not owed (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).
- CI families: the PR's check-runs.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint on the three touched source files, exit 0)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
